auxiliary_scanner/http/adobe_xml_inject.name: Adobe XML External Entity Injection

author: sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/advantech_webacce.description: This module will attempt to authenticate to Advantech WebAccess.
auxiliary_scanner/http/advantech_webacce.name: Advantech WebAccess Login

author: Jon Hart <jon_hart@rapid7.com>
Lior Oppenheim
auxiliary_scanner/http/allegro_rompager_.description:
This module scans for HTTP servers that appear to be vulnerable to the
          'Misfortune Cookie' vulnerability which affects Allegro Software
          Rompager versions before 4.34 and can allow attackers to authenticate
          to the HTTP service as an administrator without providing valid
          credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/allegro_rompager_.name: Allegro Software RomPager 'Misfortune Cookie' (CVE-2014-9222) Scanner

author: Veerendra G.G
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_activemq_s.description:
This module exploits a source code disclosure in Apache ActiveMQ. The
          vulnerability is due to the Jetty's ResourceHandler handling of specially crafted
          URI's starting with //. It has been tested successfully on Apache ActiveMQ 5.3.1
          over Windows 2003 SP2 and Ubuntu 10.04.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_activemq_s.name: Apache ActiveMQ JSP Files Source Disclosure

author: AbdulAziz Hariri
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_activemq_t.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in Apache ActiveMQ
          5.3.1 and 5.3.2 on Windows systems. The vulnerability exists in the Jetty's
          ResourceHandler installed with the affected versions. This module has been tested
          successfully on ActiveMQ 5.3.1 and 5.3.2 over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_activemq_t.name: Apache ActiveMQ Directory Traversal

author: 0rich1 - Ant Security FG Lab
Hoa Nguyen - Suncsr Team
bcoles <bcoles@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_flink_jobm.description:
This module exploits an unauthenticated directory traversal vulnerability
          in Apache Flink versions 1.11.0 <= 1.11.2. The JobManager REST API fails
          to validate user-supplied log file paths, allowing retrieval of arbitrary
          files with the privileges of the web server user.

          This module has been tested successfully on Apache Flink version 1.11.2
          on Ubuntu 18.04.4.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_flink_jobm.name: Apache Flink JobManager Traversal

author: Stephane Chazelas
wvu <wvu@metasploit.com>
lcamtuf
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_mod_cgi_ba.description:
This module scans for the Shellshock vulnerability, a flaw in how the Bash shell
          handles external environment variables. This module targets CGI scripts in the
          Apache web server by setting the HTTP_USER_AGENT environment variable to a
          malicious function definition.

          PROTIP: Use exploit/multi/handler with a PAYLOAD appropriate to your
          CMD, set ExitOnSession false, run -j, and then run this module to create
          sessions on vulnerable hosts.

          Note that this is not the recommended method for obtaining shells.
          If you require sessions, please use the apache_mod_cgi_bash_env_exec
          exploit module instead.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_mod_cgi_ba.name: Apache mod_cgi Bash Environment Variable Injection (Shellshock) Scanner

author: h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_nifi_login.description:
This module attempts to take login details for Apache NiFi websites
          and identify if they are valid or not.

          Tested against NiFi major releases 1.14.0 - 1.21.0, and 1.13.0
          Also works against NiFi <= 1.13.0, but the module needs to be adjusted:
          set SSL false
          set rport 8080
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_nifi_login.name: Apache NiFi Login Scanner

author: h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_nifi_versi.description:
This module identifies Apache NiFi websites and reports their version number.

          Tested against NiFi major releases 1.14.0 - 1.21.0, and 1.11.0-1.13.0
          Also works against NiFi <= 1.13.0, but the module needs to be adjusted:
          set SSL false
          set rport 8080
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_nifi_versi.name: Apache NiFi Version Scanner

actions.description: Check for RCE (if mod_cgi is enabled).
actions.name: CHECK_RCE

actions.description: Read file on the remote server.
actions.name: READ_FILE

author: Ash Daulton
Dhiraj Mishra
mekhalleh (RAMELLA Sébastien)
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_normalize_.description:
This module scans for an unauthenticated RCE vulnerability which exists in Apache version 2.4.49 (CVE-2021-41773).
          If files outside of the document root are not protected by 'require all denied' and CGI has been explicitly enabled,
          it can be used to execute arbitrary commands (Remote Command Execution).
          This vulnerability has been reintroduced in Apache 2.4.50 fix (CVE-2021-42013).
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_normalize_.name: Apache 2.4.49/2.4.50 Traversal RCE scanner

author: Hanno Böck
h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_optionsble.description:
This module scans for the Apache optionsbleed vulnerability where the Allow
          response header returned from an OPTIONS request may bleed memory if the
          server has a .htaccess file with an invalid Limit method defined.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_optionsble.name: Apache Optionsbleed Scanner

author: Heyder Andrade <heyder.andrade@alligatorteam.org>
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_userdir_en.description:
Apache with the UserDir directive enabled generates different error
      codes when a username exists and there is no public_html directory and when the username
      does not exist, which could allow remote attackers to determine valid usernames on the
      server.
auxiliary_scanner/http/apache_userdir_en.name: Apache "mod_userdir" User Enumeration

author: 0a29406d9794e4f9b30b3c5d6702c708
thelightcosine
auxiliary_scanner/http/appletv_login.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to an AppleTV service with
        the username, 'AirPlay'.  The device has two different access control
        modes: OnScreen and Password. The difference between the two is the
        password in OnScreen mode is numeric-only and four digits long, which
        means when this option is enabled, this option, the module will make
        sure to cover all of them - from 0000 to 9999.  The Password mode is
        more complex, therefore the usual online bruteforce strategies apply.
auxiliary_scanner/http/appletv_login.name: AppleTV AirPlay Login Utility

author: Will Caput
Trevor Hartman
Thaddeus Bogner
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/atlassian_crowd_f.description:
This module simply attempts to read a remote file from the server using a
        vulnerability in the way Atlassian Crowd handles XML files. The vulnerability
        occurs while trying to expand external entities with the SYSTEM identifier. This
        module has been tested successfully on Linux and Windows installations of Crowd.
auxiliary_scanner/http/atlassian_crowd_f.name: Atlassian Crowd XML Entity Expansion Remote File Access

author: Tiago Ferreira <tiago.ccna@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/axis_local_file_i.description:
This module exploits an Apache Axis2 v1.4.1 local file inclusion (LFI) vulnerability.
        By loading a local XML file which contains a cleartext username and password, attackers can trivially
        recover authentication credentials to Axis services.
auxiliary_scanner/http/axis_local_file_i.name: Apache Axis2 v1.4.1 Local File Inclusion

author: Leandro Oliveira <leandrofernando@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/axis_login.description:
This module attempts to login to an Apache Axis2 instance using
        username and password combinations indicated by the USER_FILE,
        PASS_FILE, and USERPASS_FILE options. It has been verified to
        work on at least versions 1.4.1 and 1.6.2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/axis_login.name: Apache Axis2 Brute Force Utility

author: Matthew Dunn - k0pak4
auxiliary_scanner/http/azure_ad_login.description:
This module enumerates valid usernames and passwords against a
        Microsoft Azure Active Directory domain by utilizing a flaw in
        how SSO authenticates.
auxiliary_scanner/http/azure_ad_login.name: Microsoft Azure Active Directory Login Enumeration

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/backup_file.description:
This module identifies the existence of possible copies
          of a specific file in a given path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/backup_file.name: HTTP Backup File Scanner

author: Tiago Ferreira <tiago.ccna@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/barracuda_directo.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability present in
        several Barracuda products, including the Barracuda Spam and Virus Firewall,
        Barracuda SSL VPN, and the Barracuda Web Application Firewall. By default,
        this module will attempt to download the Barracuda configuration file.
auxiliary_scanner/http/barracuda_directo.name: Barracuda Multiple Product "locale" Directory Traversal

author: sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/bavision_cam_logi.description:
This module will attempt to authenticate to an IP camera created by BAVision via the
          web service. By default, the vendor ships a default credential admin:123456 to its
          cameras, and the web server does not enforce lockouts in case of a bruteforce attack.
auxiliary_scanner/http/bavision_cam_logi.name: BAVision IP Camera Web Server Login

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/binom3_login_conf.description:
This module scans for Binom3 Multifunctional Revenue Energy Meter and Power Quality Analyzer
          management login portal(s), and attempts to identify valid credentials.
          There are four (4) default accounts - 'root'/'root', 'admin'/'1', 'alg'/'1', 'user'/'1'.
          In addition to device config, 'root' user can also access password file.
          Other users - admin, alg, user - can only access configuration file.
          The module attempts to download configuration and password files depending on the login user credentials found.
auxiliary_scanner/http/binom3_login_conf.name: Binom3 Web Management Login Scanner, Config and Password File Dump

author: David Aaron
Jonathan Claudius
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/bitweaver_overlay.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability found in Bitweaver.
          When handling the 'overlay_type' parameter, view_overlay.php fails to do any
          path checking/filtering, which can be abused to read any file outside the
          virtual directory.
auxiliary_scanner/http/bitweaver_overlay.name: Bitweaver overlay_type Directory Traversal

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/blind_sql_query.description:
This module identifies the existence of Blind SQL injection issues
          in GET/POST Query parameters values.
auxiliary_scanner/http/blind_sql_query.name: HTTP Blind SQL Injection Scanner

author: bperry
jhart
auxiliary_scanner/http/bmc_trackit_passw.description:
This module exploits a flaw in the password reset mechanism in BMC TrackIt! 11.3
          and possibly prior versions. If the password reset service is configured to use
          a domain administrator (which is the recommended configuration), then domain
          credentials can be reset (such as domain Administrator).
auxiliary_scanner/http/bmc_trackit_passw.name: BMC TrackIt! Unauthenticated Arbitrary User Password Change

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/brute_dirs.description:
This module identifies the existence of interesting directories by brute forcing the name
          in a given directory path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/brute_dirs.name: HTTP Directory Brute Force Scanner

author: Nicholas Starke <starke.nicholas@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/buffalo_login.description:
This module simply attempts to login to a Buffalo NAS instance using a specific
        username and password. It has been confirmed to work on version 1.68
auxiliary_scanner/http/buffalo_login.name: Buffalo NAS Login Utility

author: James Otten <jamesotten1@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/buildmaster_login.description:
This module will attempt to authenticate to BuildMaster. There is a default user 'Admin'
          which has the default password 'Admin'.
auxiliary_scanner/http/buildmaster_login.name: Inedo BuildMaster Login Scanner

author: Nixawk
auxiliary_scanner/http/caidao_bruteforce.description: This module attempts to bruteforce chinese caidao asp/php/aspx backdoor.
auxiliary_scanner/http/caidao_bruteforce.name: Chinese Caidao Backdoor Bruteforce

author: Matt "hostess" Andreko <mandreko@accuvant.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/canon_wireless.description:
This module enumerates wireless credentials from Canon printers with a web interface.
          It has been tested on Canon models: MG3100, MG5300, MG6100, MP495, MX340, MX870,
          MX890, MX920.
auxiliary_scanner/http/canon_wireless.name: Canon Printer Wireless Configuration Disclosure

author: Jeremy Brown
krastanoel
auxiliary_scanner/http/cassandra_web_fil.description:
This module exploits an unauthenticated directory traversal vulnerability in Cassandra Web
          'Cassandra Web' version 0.5.0 and earlier, allowing arbitrary file read with the web server privileges.
          This vulnerability occurred due to the disabled Rack::Protection module
auxiliary_scanner/http/cassandra_web_fil.name: Cassandra Web File Read Vulnerability

author: nebulus
auxiliary_scanner/http/cert.description:
This module will check the certificate of the specified web servers
        to ensure the subject and issuer match the supplied pattern and that the certificate
        is not expired.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cert.name: HTTP SSL Certificate Checker

author: Google Project Zero
Dhiraj Mishra
auxiliary_scanner/http/cgit_traversal.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability which
          exists in cgit < 1.2.1 cgit_clone_objects(), reachable when the
          configuration flag enable-http-clone is set to 1 (default).
auxiliary_scanner/http/cgit_traversal.name: cgit Directory Traversal

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
auxiliary_scanner/http/chef_webui_login.description:
This module attempts to login to Chef Web UI server instance using username and password
        combinations indicated by the USER_FILE, PASS_FILE, and USERPASS_FILE options. It
        will also test for the default login (admin:p@ssw0rd1).
auxiliary_scanner/http/chef_webui_login.name: Chef Web UI Brute Force Utility

author: wvu <wvu@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/chromecast_webser.description:
This module scans for the Chromecast web server on port 8008/TCP, and
          can be used to discover devices which can be targeted by other Chromecast
          modules, such as chromecast_youtube.
auxiliary_scanner/http/chromecast_webser.name: Chromecast Web Server Scanner

author: wvu <wvu@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/chromecast_wifi.description: This module enumerates wireless access points through Chromecast.
auxiliary_scanner/http/chromecast_wifi.name: Chromecast Wifi Enumeration

author: jbaines-r7
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_asa_asdm_br.description:
This module scans for the Cisco ASA ASDM landing page and performs login brute-force
          to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_asa_asdm_br.name: Cisco ASA ASDM Brute-force Login

author: Jonathan Claudius <jclaudius@trustwave.com>
jbaines-r7
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_asa_clientl.description:
This module scans for Cisco ASA Clientless SSL VPN (WebVPN) web login portals and
          performs login brute-force to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_asa_clientl.name: Cisco ASA Clientless SSL VPN (WebVPN) Brute-force Login Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_device_mana.description:
This module gathers data from a Cisco device (router or switch) with the device manager
          web interface exposed. The HttpUsername and HttpPassword options can be used to specify
          authentication.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_device_mana.name: Cisco Device HTTP Device Manager Access

author: Michał Bentkowski
Yassine Aboukir
Shelby Pace
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_directory_t.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in Cisco's Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) software and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) software.
          It lists the contents of Cisco's VPN web service which includes directories, files, and currently logged in users.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_directory_t.name: Cisco ASA Directory Traversal

author: Matt
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_firepower_d.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in Cisco Firepower Management
          under the context of www user. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_firepower_d.name: Cisco Firepower Management Console 6.0 Post Auth Report Download Directory Traversal

author: sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_firepower_l.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to a Cisco Firepower Management console via HTTPS.
          The credentials are also used for SSH, which could allow remote code execution.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_firepower_l.name: Cisco Firepower Management Console 6.0 Login

author: aushack <patrick@osisecurity.com.au>
hdm <x@hdm.io>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ios_auth_by.description:
This module exploits a vulnerability in the Cisco IOS HTTP Server.
          By sending a GET request for "/level/num/exec/..", where num is between
          16 and 99, it is possible to bypass authentication and obtain full system
          control. IOS 11.3 -> 12.2 are reportedly vulnerable. This module
          tested successfully against a Cisco 1600 Router IOS v11.3(11d).
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ios_auth_by.name: Cisco IOS HTTP Unauthorized Administrative Access

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ironport_en.description:
This module scans for Cisco Ironport SMA, WSA and ESA web login portals, finds AsyncOS
          versions, and performs login brute force to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ironport_en.name: Cisco Ironport Bruteforce Login Utility

author: Nenad Stojanovski <nenad.stojanovski@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_nac_manager.description:
This module tests whether a directory traversal vulnerability is present
        in versions of Cisco Network Access Manager 4.8.x You may wish to change
        FILE (e.g. passwd or hosts), MAXDIRS and RPORT depending on your environment.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_nac_manager.name: Cisco Network Access Manager Directory Traversal Vulnerability

author: Jonathan Claudius <jclaudius@trustwave.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ssl_vpn.description:
This module scans for Cisco SSL VPN web login portals and
          performs login brute force to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ssl_vpn.name: Cisco SSL VPN Bruteforce Login Utility

author: jclaudius <jclaudius@trustwave.com>
lguay <laura.r.guay@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ssl_vpn_pri.description:
This module exploits a privilege escalation vulnerability for Cisco
          ASA SSL VPN (aka: WebVPN). It allows level 0 users to escalate to
          level 15.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cisco_ssl_vpn_pri.name: Cisco ASA SSL VPN Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

author: Dylan Pindur
Spencer McIntyre
auxiliary_scanner/http/citrix_bleed_cve_.description:
This module scans for a vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to leak memory for a
          target Citrix ADC server. The leaked memory is then scanned for session cookies which can be hijacked if found.
auxiliary_scanner/http/citrix_bleed_cve_.name: Citrix ADC (NetScaler) Bleed Scanner

author: Mikhail Klyuchnikov
Erik Wynter
altonjx
auxiliary_scanner/http/citrix_dir_traver.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability (CVE-2019-19781) within Citrix ADC
          (NetScaler). It requests the smb.conf file located in the /vpns/cfg directory by issuing the request
          /vpn/../vpns/cfg/smb.conf. It then checks if the server is vulnerable by looking for the presence of
          a "[global]" directive in smb.conf, which this file should always contain.
auxiliary_scanner/http/citrix_dir_traver.name: Citrix ADC (NetScaler) Directory Traversal Scanner

author: blkhtc0rp
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/clansphere_traver.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal flaw found in Clansphere 2011.3.
          The application fails to handle the cs_lang parameter properly, which can be
          used to read any file outside the virtual directory.
auxiliary_scanner/http/clansphere_traver.name: ClanSphere 2011.3 Local File Inclusion Vulnerability

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/cnpilot_r_web_log.description:
This module scans for Cambium cnPilot r200/r201 management login
          portal(s), attempts to identify valid credentials, and dump device
          configuration.

          The device has at least two (2) users - admin and user. Due to an
          access control vulnerability, it is possible for 'user' account to access full
          device config. All information, including passwords, and keys, is stored
          insecurely, in clear-text form, thus allowing unauthorized admin access to any
          user.
auxiliary_scanner/http/cnpilot_r_web_log.name: Cambium cnPilot r200/r201 Login Scanner and Config Dump

author: CG <cg@carnal0wnage.com>
nebulus
auxiliary_scanner/http/coldfusion_locale.description:
This module attempts to exploit the directory traversal in the 'locale'
        attribute.  According to the advisory the following versions are vulnerable:

        ColdFusion MX6 6.1 base patches,
        ColdFusion MX7 7,0,0,91690 base patches,
        ColdFusion MX8 8,0,1,195765 base patches,
        ColdFusion MX8 8,0,1,195765 with Hotfix4.

        Adobe released patches for ColdFusion 8.0, 8.0.1, and 9 but ColdFusion 9 is reported
        to have directory traversal protections in place, subsequently this module does NOT
        work against ColdFusion 9.  Adobe did not release patches for ColdFusion 6.1 or
        ColdFusion 7.

        It is not recommended to set FILE when doing scans across a group of servers where the OS
        may vary; otherwise, the file requested may not make sense for the OS
auxiliary_scanner/http/coldfusion_locale.name: ColdFusion Server Check

author: nebulus
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/coldfusion_versio.description:
This module attempts identify various flavors of ColdFusion up to version 10
        as well as the underlying OS.
auxiliary_scanner/http/coldfusion_versio.name: ColdFusion Version Scanner

author: Chris John Riley
auxiliary_scanner/http/concrete5_member_.description: This module extracts username information from the Concrete5 member page
auxiliary_scanner/http/concrete5_member_.name: Concrete5 Member List Enumeration

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/copy_of_file.description:
This module identifies the existence of possible copies
          of a specific file in a given path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/copy_of_file.name: HTTP Copy File Scanner

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
tasos
auxiliary_scanner/http/crawler.description: Crawl a web site and store information about what was found
auxiliary_scanner/http/crawler.name: Web Site Crawler

author: Cristiano Maruti <cmaruti@gmail.com>
h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/dell_idrac.description:
This module attempts to login to a iDRAC webserver instance using
        default username and password.  Tested against Dell Remote Access
        Controller 6 - Express version 1.50 and 1.85,
        Controller 7 - Enterprise 2.63.60.62
        Controller 8 - Enterprise 2.83.05
        Controller 9 - Enterprise 4.40.00.00
auxiliary_scanner/http/dell_idrac.name: Dell iDRAC Default Login

author: Carlos Avila
h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/dicoogle_traversa.description:
This module exploits an unauthenticated directory traversal vulnerability
          in the Dicoogle PACS Web Server v2.5.0 and possibly earlier, allowing an
          attacker to read arbitrary files with the web server privileges.
          While the application is java based, the directory traversal was only
          successful against Windows targets.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dicoogle_traversa.name: Dicoogle PACS Web Server Directory Traversal

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_listing.description:
This module identifies directory listing vulnerabilities
          in a given directory path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_listing.name: HTTP Directory Listing Scanner

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_scanner.description:
This module identifies the existence of interesting directories
          in a given directory path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_scanner.name: HTTP Directory Scanner

author: aushack <patrick@osisecurity.com.au>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_webdav_unicod.description:
This module is based on et's HTTP Directory Scanner module,
          with one exception. Where authentication is required, it attempts
          to bypass authentication using the WebDAV IIS6 Unicode vulnerability
          discovered by Kingcope. The vulnerability appears to be exploitable
          where WebDAV is enabled on the IIS6 server, and any protected folder
          requires either Basic, Digest or NTLM authentication.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dir_webdav_unicod.name: MS09-020 IIS6 WebDAV Unicode Auth Bypass Directory Scanner

author: Nick Marcoccio "1oopho1e" <iremembermodems@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/directadmin_login.description: This module will attempt to authenticate to a DirectAdmin Web Control Panel.
auxiliary_scanner/http/directadmin_login.name: DirectAdmin Web Control Panel Login Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
Michael Messner <devnull@s3cur1ty.de>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_300_615.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to different D-Link HTTP management
        services. It has been tested on D-Link DIR-300 Hardware revision A, D-Link DIR-615
        Hardware revision D and D-Link DIR-320 devices. It is possible that this module
        also works with other models.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_300_615.name: D-Link DIR-300A / DIR-320 / DIR-615D HTTP Login Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
Michael Messner <devnull@s3cur1ty.de>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_615h_ht.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to different D-Link HTTP management
        services. It has been tested successfully on D-Link DIR-615 Hardware revision H
        devices. It is possible that this module also works with other models.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_615h_ht.name: D-Link DIR-615H HTTP Login Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
Michael Messner <devnull@s3cur1ty.de>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_session.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to different D-Link HTTP management
        services. It has been tested successfully on D-Link DIR-300 Hardware revision B,
        D-Link DIR-600 Hardware revision B, D-Link DIR-815 Hardware revision A and DIR-645
        Hardware revision A devices. It is possible that this module also works with other
        models.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_dir_session.name: D-Link DIR-300B / DIR-600B / DIR-815 / DIR-645 HTTP Login Utility

author: Craig Heffner
Michael Messner <devnull@s3cur1ty.de>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_user_agent_.description:
This module attempts to find D-Link devices running Alphanetworks web interfaces affected
        by the backdoor found on the User-Agent header. This module has been tested successfully
        on a DIR-100 device with firmware version v1.13.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dlink_user_agent_.name: D-Link User-Agent Backdoor Scanner

author: h00die <mike@shorebreaksecurity.com>
flakey_biscuit <nicholas@shorebreaksecurity.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dnalims_file_retr.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability found in dnaLIMS.
          Due to the way the viewAppletFsa.cgi script handles the 'secID' parameter, it is possible
          to read a file outside the www directory.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dnalims_file_retr.name: DnaLIMS Directory Traversal

author: Agora-Security
auxiliary_scanner/http/docker_version.description:
This module attempts to identify the version of a Docker Server running on a
          host. If you wish to see all the information available, set VERBOSE to true.
auxiliary_scanner/http/docker_version.name: Docker Server Version Scanner

author: Vladimir TOUTAIN
Nolan LOSSIGNOL-DRILLIEN
auxiliary_scanner/http/dolibarr_16_conta.description:
Dolibarr version 16 < 16.0.5 is vulnerable to a pre-authentication contact database dump.
          An unauthenticated attacker may retrieve a company's entire customer file, prospects, suppliers,
          and potentially employee information if a contact file exists.
          Both public and private notes are also included in the dump.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dolibarr_16_conta.name: Dolibarr 16 pre-auth contact database dump

author: sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/dolibarr_login.description:
This module attempts to authenticate to a Dolibarr ERP/CRM's admin web interface,
          and should only work against version 3.1.1 or older, because these versions do not
          have any default protections against brute forcing.
auxiliary_scanner/http/dolibarr_login.name: Dolibarr ERP/CRM Login Utility

author: Justin Klein Keane
Robin Francois <rof@navixia.com>
Brandon McCann "zeknox" <bmccann@accuvant.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/drupal_views_user.description:
This module exploits an information disclosure vulnerability in the 'Views'
          module of Drupal, brute-forcing the first 10 usernames from 'a' to 'z'.
          Drupal 6 with 'Views' module <= 6.x-2.11 are vulnerable.  Drupal does not
          consider disclosure of usernames as a weakness.
auxiliary_scanner/http/drupal_views_user.name: Drupal Views Module Users Enumeration

author: Justin Cacak
auxiliary_scanner/http/ektron_cms400net.description:
Ektron CMS400.NET is a web content management system based on .NET.
          This module tests for installations that are utilizing default
          passwords set by the vendor. Additionally, it has the ability
          to brute force user accounts. Note that Ektron CMS400.NET, by
          default, enforces account lockouts for regular user account
          after a number of failed attempts.
auxiliary_scanner/http/ektron_cms400net.name: Ektron CMS400.NET Default Password Scanner

author: h00die
Eric Howard
R0NY
auxiliary_scanner/http/elasticsearch_mem.description:
This module exploits a memory disclosure vulnerability in Elasticsearch
          7.10.0 to 7.13.3 (inclusive). A user with the ability to submit arbitrary
          queries to Elasticsearch can generate an error message containing previously
          used portions of a data buffer.
          This buffer could contain sensitive information such as Elasticsearch
          documents or authentication details. This vulnerability's output is similar
          to heartbleed.
auxiliary_scanner/http/elasticsearch_mem.name: Elasticsearch Memory Disclosure

author: Benjamin Smith
Pedro Andujar <pandujar@segfault.es>
Jose A. Guasch <jaguasch@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/elasticsearch_tra.description:
'This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in
          ElasticSearch, allowing an attacker to read arbitrary files
          with JVM process privileges, through the Snapshot API.'
auxiliary_scanner/http/elasticsearch_tra.name: ElasticSearch Snapshot API Directory Traversal

author: Btnz
auxiliary_scanner/http/emby_ssrf_scanner.description:
Generates a `GET` request to the provided web servers and executes an SSRF against
                        the targeted EMBY server. Returns the server header, HTML title attribute and
                        location header (if set). This is useful for rapidly identifying web applications
                        on the internal network using the Emby SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2020-26948).
auxiliary_scanner/http/emby_ssrf_scanner.name: Emby SSRF HTTP Scanner

author: Btnz
auxiliary_scanner/http/emby_version_ssrf.description:
This module attempts to identify the version of an Emby Media Server running on a
                        host. If you wish to see all the information available, set VERBOSE to true. Use in
                        conjunction with emby_ssrf_scanner to locate devices vulnerable to CVE-2020-26948.
auxiliary_scanner/http/emby_version_ssrf.name: Emby Version Scanner

author: mubix <mubix@hak5.org>
auxiliary_scanner/http/enum_wayback.description:
This module pulls and parses the URLs stored by Archive.org for the purpose of
          replaying during a web assessment. Finding unlinked and old pages.
auxiliary_scanner/http/enum_wayback.name: Archive.org Stored Domain URLs

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_dump_con.description:
This module dumps Cambium ePMP 1000 device configuration file. An
          ePMP 1000 box has four (4) login accounts - admin/admin, installer/installer,
          home/home, and readonly/readonly. This module requires any one of the following
          login credentials - admin / installer / home - to dump device configuration
          file.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_dump_con.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 Dump Device Config

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_dump_has.description:
This module exploits an OS Command Injection vulnerability in Cambium
          ePMP 1000 (<v2.5) device management portal. It requires any one of the
          following login credentials - admin/admin, installer/installer, home/home - to
          dump system hashes.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_dump_has.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 'ping' Password Hash Extractor (up to v2.5)

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_get_char.description:
This module exploits an OS Command Injection vulnerability in Cambium
          ePMP 1000 (v3.1-3.5-RC7) device management portal. It requires any one of the
          following login credentials - admin/admin, installer/installer, home/home - to
          execute arbitrary system commands.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_get_char.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 'get_chart' Command Injection (v3.1-3.5-RC7)

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_ping_cmd.description:
This module exploits an OS Command Injection vulnerability in Cambium
          ePMP 1000 (<v2.5) device management portal. It requires any one of the
          following login credentials - admin/admin, installer/installer, home/home - to
          execute arbitrary system commands.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_ping_cmd.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 'ping' Command Injection (up to v2.5)

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_reset_pa.description:
This module exploits an access control vulnerability in Cambium ePMP
          device management portal. It requires any one of the following non-admin login
          credentials - installer/installer, home/home - to reset password of other
          existing user(s) including 'admin'. All versions <=3.5 are affected. This
          module works on versions 3.0-3.5-RC7.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_reset_pa.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 Account Password Reset

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_web_logi.description:
This module scans for Cambium ePMP 1000 management login portal(s), and
          attempts to identify valid credentials. Default login credentials are -
          admin/admin, installer/installer, home/home and readonly/readonly.
auxiliary_scanner/http/epmp1000_web_logi.name: Cambium ePMP 1000 Login Scanner

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/error_sql_injecti.description: This module identifies the existence of Error Based SQL injection issues. Still requires a lot of work
auxiliary_scanner/http/error_sql_injecti.name: HTTP Error Based SQL Injection Scanner

moonbocal

h00die
auxiliary_scanner/http/es_file_explorer_.description:
This module connects to ES File Explorer's HTTP server to run
        certain commands. The HTTP server is started on app launch, and is available
        as long as the app is open. Version 4.1.9.7.4 and below are reported vulnerable
        This module has been tested against 4.1.9.5.1.
auxiliary_scanner/http/es_file_explorer_.name: ES File Explorer Open Port

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/etherpad_duo_logi.description:
This module scans for EtherPAD Duo login portal, and
          performs a login bruteforce attack to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/etherpad_duo_logi.name: EtherPAD Duo Login Bruteforce Utility

author: Orange Tsai
mekhalleh (RAMELLA Sébastien)
auxiliary_scanner/http/exchange_proxylog.description:
This module scan for a vulnerability on Microsoft Exchange Server that
          allows an attacker bypassing the authentication and impersonating as the
          admin (CVE-2021-26855).

          By chaining this bug with another post-auth arbitrary-file-write
          vulnerability to get code execution (CVE-2021-27065).

          As a result, an unauthenticated attacker can execute arbitrary commands on
          Microsoft Exchange Server.

          This vulnerability affects (Exchange 2013 Versions < 15.00.1497.012,
          Exchange 2016 CU18 < 15.01.2106.013, Exchange 2016 CU19 < 15.01.2176.009,
          Exchange 2019 CU7 < 15.02.0721.013, Exchange 2019 CU8 < 15.02.0792.010).

          All components are vulnerable by default.
auxiliary_scanner/http/exchange_proxylog.name: Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon Scanner

author: _dirkjan
Petros Koutroumpis
auxiliary_scanner/http/exchange_web_serv.description:
This module exploits a privilege escalation vulnerability found in Microsoft Exchange - CVE-2019-0724
        Execution of the module will force Exchange to authenticate to an arbitrary URL over HTTP via the Exchange PushSubscription feature.
        This allows us to relay the NTLM authentication to a Domain Controller and authenticate with the privileges that Exchange is configured.
        The module is based on the work by @_dirkjan,
auxiliary_scanner/http/exchange_web_serv.name: Microsoft Exchange Privilege Escalation Exploit

author: Denis Kolegov <dnkolegov@gmail.com>
Oleg Broslavsky <ovbroslavsky@gmail.com>
Nikita Oleksov <neoleksov@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/f5_bigip_virtual_.description:
This module scans for BigIP HTTP virtual servers using banner grabbing. BigIP system uses
          different HTTP profiles for managing HTTP traffic and these profiles allow to customize
          the string used as Server HTTP header. The default values are "BigIP" or "BIG-IP" depending
          on the BigIP system version.
auxiliary_scanner/http/f5_bigip_virtual_.name: F5 BigIP HTTP Virtual Server Scanner

author: Denis Kolegov <dnkolegov@gmail.com>
Oleg Broslavsky <ovbroslavsky@gmail.com>
Nikita Oleksov <neoleksov@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/f5_mgmt_scanner.description:
This module attempts to identify the web management interfaces of the following
          F5 Networks devices:
          BigIP, BigIQ, Enterprise Manager, ARX, and FirePass.
auxiliary_scanner/http/f5_mgmt_scanner.name: F5 Networks Devices Management Interface Scanner

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/file_same_name_di.description:
This module identifies the existence of files
          in a given directory path named as the same name of the
          directory.

          Only works if PATH is different than '/'.
auxiliary_scanner/http/file_same_name_di.name: HTTP File Same Name Directory Scanner

author: et <et@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/files_dir.description:
This module identifies the existence of interesting files
          in a given directory path.
auxiliary_scanner/http/files_dir.name: HTTP Interesting File Scanner

author: Mike Connor
Juerg Schweingruber <juerg.schweingruber@redguard.ch>
Patrick Schmid <patrick.schmid@redguard.ch>
auxiliary_scanner/http/fortimail_login_b.description:
This module attempts to detect instances of FortiMail vulnerable
        against an unauthenticated login bypass (CVE-2020-9294).
auxiliary_scanner/http/fortimail_login_b.name: FortiMail Unauthenticated Login Bypass Scanner

author: Max Michels <kontakt@maxmichels.de>
auxiliary_scanner/http/fortinet_ssl_vpn.description:
This module scans for Fortinet SSL VPN web login portals and
          performs login brute force to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/fortinet_ssl_vpn.name: Fortinet SSL VPN Bruteforce Login Utility

author: Aditya K Sood <Aditya K Sood @adityaksood>
Stephen Haywood <Stephen Haywood @averagesecguy>
auxiliary_scanner/http/frontpage_credent.description:
This module downloads and parses the '_vti_pvt/service.pwd',
          '_vti_pvt/administrators.pwd', and '_vti_pvt/authors.pwd' files on a FrontPage
          server to find credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/frontpage_credent.name: FrontPage .pwd File Credential Dump

author: Matteo Cantoni <goony@nothink.org>
auxiliary_scanner/http/frontpage_login.description: This module queries the FrontPage Server Extensions and determines whether anonymous access is allowed.
auxiliary_scanner/http/frontpage_login.name: FrontPage Server Extensions Anonymous Login Scanner

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/gavazzi_em_login_.description: This module scans for Carlo Gavazzi Energy Meters login portals, performs a login brute force attack, enumerates device firmware version, and attempt to extract the SMTP configuration. A valid, admin privileged user is required to extract the SMTP password. In some older firmware versions, the SMTP config can be retrieved without any authentication. The module also exploits an access control vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated user to remotely dump the database file EWplant.db. This db file contains information such as power/energy utilization data, tariffs, and revenue statistics. Vulnerable firmware versions include - VMU-C EM prior to firmware Version A11_U05 and VMU-C PV prior to firmware Version A17.
auxiliary_scanner/http/gavazzi_em_login_.name: Carlo Gavazzi Energy Meters - Login Brute Force, Extract Info and Dump Plant Database

author: Nixawk
Jon Hart <jon_hart@rapid7.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/git_scanner.description:
This module can detect situations where there may be information
        disclosure vulnerabilities that occur when a Git repository is made
        available over HTTP.
auxiliary_scanner/http/git_scanner.name: HTTP Git Scanner

author: jbaines-r7
mungsul
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_graphql_us.description:
This module queries the GitLab GraphQL API without authentication
          to acquire the list of GitLab users (CVE-2021-4191). The module works
          on all GitLab versions from 13.0 up to 14.8.2, 14.7.4, and 14.6.5.
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_graphql_us.name: GitLab GraphQL API User Enumeration

author: Ben Campbell <eat_meatballs@hotmail.co.uk>
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_login.description: This module attempts to login to a GitLab instance using a specific user/pass.
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_login.name: GitLab Login Utility

author: Ben Campbell <eat_meatballs@hotmail.co.uk>
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_user_enum.description:
The GitLab 'internal' API is exposed unauthenticated on GitLab. This
          allows the username for each SSH Key ID number to be retrieved. Users
          who do not have an SSH Key cannot be enumerated in this fashion. LDAP
          users, e.g. Active Directory users will also be returned. This issue
          was fixed in GitLab v7.5.0 and is present from GitLab v5.0.0.
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_user_enum.name: GitLab User Enumeration

author: Julien (jvoisin) Voisin
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_version.description: This module scans a Gitlab install for information about its version.
auxiliary_scanner/http/gitlab_version.name: Gitlab Version Scanner

author: Joshua Abraham <jabra@spl0it.org>
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/glassfish_login.description:
This module attempts to login to GlassFish instance using username and password
        combinations indicated by the USER_FILE, PASS_FILE, and USERPASS_FILE options.
        It will also try to do an authentication bypass against older versions of GlassFish.
        Note: by default, GlassFish 4.0 requires HTTPS, which means you must set the SSL option
        to true, and SSLVersion to TLS1. It also needs Secure Admin to access the DAS remotely.
auxiliary_scanner/http/glassfish_login.name: GlassFish Brute Force Utility

author: Trustwave SpiderLabs
Dhiraj Mishra
auxiliary_scanner/http/glassfish_travers.description:
This module exploits an unauthenticated directory traversal vulnerability
          which exists in administration console of Oracle GlassFish Server 4.1, which is
          listening by default on port 4848/TCP.
auxiliary_scanner/http/glassfish_travers.name: Path Traversal in Oracle GlassFish Server Open Source Edition

author: Matthew Daley
Roberto Soares Espreto <robertoespreto@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/goahead_traversal.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in the Embedthis
          GoAhead Web Server v3.4.1, allowing an attacker to read arbitrary files
          with the web server privileges.
auxiliary_scanner/http/goahead_traversal.name: Embedthis GoAhead Embedded Web Server Directory Traversal

author: h00die
jordyv
auxiliary_scanner/http/grafana_plugin_tr.description:
Grafana versions 8.0.0-beta1 through 8.3.0 prior to 8.0.7, 8.1.8, 8.2.7, or 8.3.1 are vulnerable to directory traversal
          through the plugin URL.  A valid plugin ID is required, but many are installed by default.
auxiliary_scanner/http/grafana_plugin_tr.name: Grafana Plugin Path Traversal

author: sjanusz-r7
auxiliary_scanner/http/graphql_introspec.description:
This module queries a GraphQL API Endpoint to retrieve schema data by using
          introspection, if it is enabled on the server. This module works on all GraphQL versions.
auxiliary_scanner/http/graphql_introspec.name: GraphQL Introspection Scanner

author: r () b13$
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/groupwise_agents_.description:
This module exploits a directory traversal vulnerability in Novell Groupwise.
          The vulnerability exists in the web interface of both the Post Office and the
          MTA agents. This module has been tested successfully on Novell Groupwise 8.02 HP2
          over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/groupwise_agents_.name: Novell Groupwise Agents HTTP Directory Traversal

author: Jay Turla
Medz Barao
auxiliary_scanner/http/host_header_injec.description: Checks if the host is vulnerable to Host header injection
auxiliary_scanner/http/host_header_injec.name: HTTP Host Header Injection Detection

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_bims_downl.description:
This module exploits a lack of authentication and a directory traversal in HP
          Intelligent Management, specifically in the DownloadServlet from the BIMS component,
          in order to retrieve arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges. This module has been
          tested successfully on HP Intelligent Management Center 5.1 E0202 with BIMS 5.1 E0201
          over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_bims_downl.name: HP Intelligent Management BIMS DownloadServlet Directory Traversal

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_faultdownl.description:
This module exploits a lack of authentication and a directory traversal in HP
          Intelligent Management, specifically in the FaultDownloadServlet, in order to
          retrieve arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges. This module has been tested
          successfully on HP Intelligent Management Center 5.1 E0202 over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_faultdownl.name: HP Intelligent Management FaultDownloadServlet Directory Traversal

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_ictdownloa.description:
This module exploits a lack of authentication and a directory traversal in HP
          Intelligent Management, specifically in the IctDownloadServlet, in order to
          retrieve arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges. This module has been tested
          successfully on HP Intelligent Management Center 5.1 E0202 over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_ictdownloa.name: HP Intelligent Management IctDownloadServlet Directory Traversal

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_reportimgs.description:
This module exploits a lack of authentication and a directory traversal in HP
          Intelligent Management, specifically in the ReportImgServlt, in order to retrieve
          arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges. This module has been tested successfully on
          HP Intelligent Management Center 5.1 E0202 over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_reportimgs.name: HP Intelligent Management ReportImgServlt Directory Traversal

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_som_file_d.description:
This module exploits a lack of authentication and access control in HP Intelligent
          Management, specifically in the FileDownloadServlet from the SOM component, in order to
          retrieve arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges. This module has been tested successfully
          on HP Intelligent Management Center 5.2_E0401 with SOM 5.2 E0401 over Windows 2003 SP2.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_imc_som_file_d.name: HP Intelligent Management SOM FileDownloadServlet Arbitrary Download

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_getf.description:
This module exploits an authentication bypass vulnerability in HP SiteScope to
        retrieve an arbitrary file from the remote server. It is accomplished by calling
        the getFileInternal operation available through the APISiteScopeImpl AXIS service.
        This module has been successfully tested on HP SiteScope 11.20 over Windows 2003
        SP2 and Linux Centos 6.3.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_getf.name: HP SiteScope SOAP Call getFileInternal Remote File Access

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_gets.description:
This module exploits an authentication bypass vulnerability in HP SiteScope
        which allows to retrieve the HP SiteScope configuration, including administrative
        credentials. It is accomplished by calling the getSiteScopeConfiguration operation
        available through the APISiteScopeImpl AXIS service. The HP SiteScope Configuration
        is retrieved as file containing Java serialization data. This module has been
        tested successfully on HP SiteScope 11.20 over Windows 2003 SP2 and Linux Centos
        6.3.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_gets.name: HP SiteScope SOAP Call getSiteScopeConfiguration Configuration Access

author: rgod <rgod@autistici.org>
juan vazquez <juan.vazquez@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_load.description:
This module exploits an authentication bypass vulnerability in HP SiteScope to
        retrieve an arbitrary text file from the remote server. It is accomplished by
        calling the loadFileContent operation available through the APIMonitorImpl AXIS
        service. This module has been successfully tested on HP SiteScope 11.20 over
        Windows 2003 SP2 and Linux Centos 6.3.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sitescope_load.name: HP SiteScope SOAP Call loadFileContent Remote File Access

author: sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sys_mgmt_login.description:
This module attempts to login to HP System Management Homepage using host
          operating system authentication.
auxiliary_scanner/http/hp_sys_mgmt_login.name: HP System Management Homepage Login Utility

author: Christian Mehlmauer <FireFart@gmail.com>
rick2600

auxiliary_scanner/http/http_hsts.description: Display HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) information about each system.

auxiliary_scanner/http/http_login.description: This module attempts to authenticate to an HTTP service.

CG <cg@carnal0wnage.com>
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_put.description:
This module can abuse misconfigured web servers to upload and delete web content
        via PUT and DELETE HTTP requests. Set ACTION to either PUT or DELETE.

        PUT is the default.  If filename isn't specified, the module will generate a
        random string for you as a .txt file. If DELETE is used, a filename is required.
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_put.name: HTTP Writable Path PUT/DELETE File Access

author: Sven Fassbender
Shelby Pace
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_sickrage_pas.description:
SickRage < v2018-09-03 allows an attacker to view a user's saved Github credentials in HTTP
          responses unless the user has set login information for SickRage.

          By default, SickRage does not require login information for the installation.
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_sickrage_pas.name: HTTP SickRage Password Leak

author: Ewerson Guimaraes(Crash) <crash@dclabs.com.br>
Michael Messner <devnull@s3cur1ty.de>
et <et@cyberspace.org>
sinn3r <sinn3r@metasploit.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_traversal.description:
This module allows you to test if a web server (or web application) is
          vulnerable to directory traversal with three different actions.

          The 'CHECK' action (default) is used to automatically (or manually) find if
          directory traversal exists in the web server, and then return the path that
          triggers the vulnerability.  The 'DOWNLOAD' action shares the same ability as
          'CHECK', but will take advantage of the found trigger to download files based on
          a 'FILELIST' of your choosing.  The 'PHPSOURCE' action can be used to download
          source against PHP applications.  The 'WRITABLE' action can be used to determine
          if the trigger can be used to write files outside the www directory.

          To use the 'COOKIE' option, set your value like so: "name=value".
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_traversal.name: Generic HTTP Directory Traversal Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_version.description: Display version information about each system.
auxiliary_scanner/http/http_version.name: HTTP Version Detection

author: mubix <mubix@hak5.org>
auxiliary_scanner/http/httpbl_lookup.description:
This module can be used to enumerate information
          about an IP addresses from Project HoneyPot's HTTP Block List.
auxiliary_scanner/http/httpbl_lookup.name: Http:BL Lookup

author: John Leitch
Shelby Pace
auxiliary_scanner/http/httpdasm_director.description: This module allows for traversing the file system of a host running httpdasm v0.92.
auxiliary_scanner/http/httpdasm_director.name: Httpdasm Directory Traversal

author: h00die
Jacob Ebben
Thomas Chauchefoin
auxiliary_scanner/http/icinga_static_lib.description:
Icingaweb versions from 2.9.0 to 2.9.5 inclusive, and 2.8.0 to 2.8.5 inclusive suffer from an
          unauthenticated directory traversal vulnerability. The vulnerability is triggered
          through the icinga-php-thirdparty library, which allows unauthenticated users
          to retrieve arbitrary files from the targets filesystem via a GET request to
          /lib/icinga/icinga-php-thirdparty/<absolute path to target file on disk> as the user
          running the Icingaweb server, which will typically be the www-data user.

          This can then be used to retrieve sensitive configuration information from the target
          such as the configuration of various services, which may reveal sensitive login
          or configuration information, the /etc/passwd file to get a list of valid usernames
          for password guessing attacks, or other sensitive files which may exist as part of
          additional functionality available on the target server.

          This module was tested against Icingaweb 2.9.5 running on Docker.
auxiliary_scanner/http/icinga_static_lib.name: Icingaweb Directory Traversal in Static Library File Requests

author: Heather Pilkington
Matthew Dunn - k0pak4
auxiliary_scanner/http/iis_internal_ip.description:
Collect any leaked internal IPs by requesting commonly redirected locations from IIS.
          CVE-2000-0649 references IIS 5.1 (win2k, XP) and older.  However, in newer servers
          such as IIS 7+, this occurs when the alternateHostName is not set or misconfigured. Also
          collects internal IPs leaked from the PROPFIND method in certain IIS versions.
auxiliary_scanner/http/iis_internal_ip.name: Microsoft IIS HTTP Internal IP Disclosure

author: Soroush Dalili
Ali Abbasnejad
MinatoTW <shaks19jais@gmail.com>
egre55 <ianaustin@protonmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/iis_shortname_sca.description:
The vulnerability is caused by a tilde character "~" in a GET or OPTIONS request, which
          could allow remote attackers to disclose 8.3 filenames (short names). In 2010, Soroush Dalili
          and Ali Abbasnejad discovered the original bug (GET request). This was publicly disclosed in
          2012. In 2014, Soroush Dalili discovered that newer IIS installations are vulnerable with OPTIONS.
auxiliary_scanner/http/iis_shortname_sca.name: Microsoft IIS shortname vulnerability scanner

author: Roberto Soares Espreto <robertoespreto@gmail.com>
Nixawk
auxiliary_scanner/http/influxdb_enum.description:
This module enumerates databases on InfluxDB using the REST API using the
          default authentication of root:root.
auxiliary_scanner/http/influxdb_enum.name: InfluxDB Enum Utility

author: Karn Ganeshen <KarnGaneshen@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/infovista_enum.description:
This module attempts to scan for InfoVista VistaPortal Web Application, finds its
          version and performs login brute force to identify valid credentials.
auxiliary_scanner/http/infovista_enum.name: InfoVista VistaPortal Application Bruteforce Login Utility

author: hdm <x@hdm.io>
auxiliary_scanner/http/intel_amt_digest_.description:
This module scans for Intel Active Management Technology endpoints and attempts
        to bypass authentication using a blank HTTP digest (CVE-2017-5689). This service
        can be found on ports 16992, 16993 (tls), 623, and 624 (tls).
auxiliary_scanner/http/intel_amt_digest_.name: Intel AMT Digest Authentication Bypass Scanner

author: Christopher Truncer chris <Christopher Truncer chris@christophertruncer.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/ipboard_login.description:
This module attempts to validate user provided credentials against
        an IP Board web application.
auxiliary_scanner/http/ipboard_login.name: IP Board Login Auxiliary Module

author: Matteo Cantoni <goony@nothink.org>
auxiliary_scanner/http/jboss_status.description:
This module queries the JBoss status servlet to collect sensitive
        information, including URL paths, GET parameters and client IP addresses.
        This module has been tested against JBoss 4.0, 4.2.2 and 4.2.3.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jboss_status.name: JBoss Status Servlet Information Gathering

author: Tyler Krpata
Zach Grace <@ztgrace>
auxiliary_scanner/http/jboss_vulnscan.description: This module scans a JBoss instance for a few vulnerabilities.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jboss_vulnscan.name: JBoss Vulnerability Scanner

author: altonjx
Jeffrey Cap
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_command.description:
This module scans for unauthenticated Jenkins-CI script consoles and
          executes the specified command.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_command.name: Jenkins-CI Unauthenticated Script-Console Scanner

author: Jeff McCutchan
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_enum.description:
This module enumerates a remote Jenkins-CI installation in an unauthenticated manner, including
          host operating system and Jenkins installation details.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_enum.name: Jenkins-CI Enumeration

author: Nicholas Starke <starke.nicholas@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_login.description: This module attempts to login to a Jenkins-CI instance using a specific user/pass.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jenkins_login.name: Jenkins-CI Login Utility

author: Brian Halbach
Mikhail Klyuchnikov
auxiliary_scanner/http/jira_user_enum.description:
This module exploits an information disclosure vulnerability that allows an
          unauthenticated user to enumerate users in the /ViewUserHover.jspa endpoint.
          This only affects Jira versions < 7.13.16, 8.0.0 <= version < 8.5.7, 8.6.0 <= version < 8.11.1
          Discovered by Mikhail Klyuchnikov @__mn1__
          This module has been tested on versions 8.4.1, 8.5.6, 8.10.1, 8.11.0
auxiliary_scanner/http/jira_user_enum.name: Jira Users Enumeration

author: h00die
Tianji Lab
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_api_improp.description:
Joomla versions between 4.0.0 and 4.2.7, inclusive, contain an improper API access vulnerability.
          This vulnerability allows unauthenticated users access to webservice endpoints which contain
          sensitive information. Specifically for this module we exploit the users and config/application
          endpoints.

          This module was tested against Joomla 4.2.7 running on Docker.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_api_improp.name: Joomla API Improper Access Checks

author: luisco100 <luisco100@gmail.com>
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_bruteforce.description: This module attempts to authenticate to Joomla 2.5. or 3.0 through bruteforce attacks
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_bruteforce.name: Joomla Bruteforce Login Utility

author: bperry
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_ecommercew.description:
This module will scan for hosts vulnerable to an unauthenticated SQL injection within the
          advanced search feature of the Web-Dorado ECommerce WD 1.2.5 and likely prior.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_ecommercew.name: Web-Dorado ECommerce WD for Joomla! search_category_id SQL Injection Scanner

author: CrashBandicoot
bperry
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_gallerywd_.description:
This module will scan for Joomla! instances vulnerable to an unauthenticated SQL injection
          within the Gallery WD for Joomla! extension version 1.2.5 and likely prior.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_gallerywd_.name: Gallery WD for Joomla! Unauthenticated SQL Injection Scanner

author: newpid0
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_pages.description: This module scans a Joomla install for common pages.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_pages.name: Joomla Page Scanner

author: newpid0
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_plugins.description:
This module scans a Joomla install for plugins and potential
        vulnerabilities.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_plugins.name: Joomla Plugins Scanner

author: newpid0
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_version.description:
This module scans a Joomla install for information about the underlying
        operating system and Joomla version.
auxiliary_scanner/http/joomla_version.name: Joomla Version Scanner

author: Spencer McIntyre
auxiliary_scanner/http/jupyter_login.description:
This module checks if authentication is required on a Jupyter Lab or Notebook server. If it is, this module will
        bruteforce the password. Jupyter only requires a password to authenticate, usernames are not used. This module
        is compatible with versions 4.3.0 (released 2016-12-08) and newer.
auxiliary_scanner/http/jupyter_login.name: Jupyter Login Utility

author: Eric Flokstra
jvoisin
auxiliary_scanner/http/kodi_traversal.description: This module exploits a directory traversal flaw found in Kodi before 17.1.
auxiliary_scanner/http/kodi_traversal.name: Kodi 17.0 Local File Inclusion Vulnerability

author: h00die
Matthew Aberegg
Michael Burkey
Federico Fernandez
Alejandro Parodi
auxiliary_scanner/http/limesurvey_zip_tr.description:
This module exploits an authenticated path traversal vulnerability found in LimeSurvey
          versions between 4.0 and 4.1.11 with CVE-2020-11455 or <= 3.15.9 with CVE-2019-9960,
          inclusive.
          In CVE-2020-11455 the getZipFile function within the filemanager functionality
          allows for arbitrary file download.  The file retrieved may be deleted after viewing,
          which was confirmed in testing.
          In CVE-2019-9960 the szip function within the downloadZip functionality allows
          for arbitrary file download.
          Verified against 4.1.11-200316, 3.15.0-181008, 3.9.0-180604, 3.6.0-180328,
          3.0.0-171222, and 2.70.0-170921.
auxiliary_scanner/http/limesurvey_zip_tr.name: LimeSurvey Zip Path Traversals
